items.markdown:
![Kata Beach: 10 Reasons to visit Kata Beach in Phuket](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07271347-1672-0139-0000-c3611738f967:4)
Kata Beach is a scenic 1.5-km golden sand bay in [Phuket](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-beach/) , known for [family-friendly swimming](https://www.thavornpalmbeach.com/tips-kata-beach-travel-guide) , surf spots, and relaxed nightlife. It features clear blue water, nearby local markets, and easy access from Phuket Airport.[](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-beach/) [[1]](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-beach/)[[2]](https://uk.hotels.com/go/thailand/kata-beach)[[3]](https://www.thavornpalmbeach.com/tips-kata-beach-travel-guide)

Key Activities and Attractions

- **Swimming and Sunbathing:** Best enjoyed on the soft sands with chair rentals available from November to April.
- **Surfing:** Popular during the low monsoon season from May to October at the northern break or Super Surf Kata.
- **Family Fun:** Includes the dinosaur-themed Dino Park Mini Golf.
- **Shopping and Nightlife:** Explored via the Kata Night Market and local bars along Thanon Thai Na.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket-kata-beach/holidays-phuket-kata-beach.html) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket-kata-beach/holidays-phuket-kata-beach.html)[[2]](https://www.hotels.com/go/thailand/kata-beach)[[3]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket-kata-beach/holidays-phuket-kata-beach/things-to-do)

Travel and Logistics

- **Best Time to Visit:** December to April for calm, clear swimming conditions.
- **Airport Transfer:** Roughly a 60 to 75-minute drive from Phuket International Airport via taxi or private transfer.
- **Nearby Spots:** Close to Kata Noi Beach (500 meters south) and Karon Viewpoint (3 km south).[](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-beach/) [[1]](https://boathouse-phuket.com/blog/kata-beach-10-reasons-to-visit-kata-beach-in-phuket)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/phuket101/posts/kata-beach-is-one-of-those-places-people-often-ask-about-in-the-phuket-groups-wh/1547165023441572/)[[3]](https://simplydominican.com/playa-minitas/)

references.title: Kata Beach is one of those places people often ask about in the Phuket groups. Where to stay that is not Patong but still has plenty going on for every kind of traveller, day and night? Kata is usually my first answer. The beach itself is 1.5 km of soft sand with that little island sitting in the bay. Makes for brilliant sunset photos, too. The sea is great from December to April. During the monsoon, it gets rough and red flags go up, but surfers love it then. Kata is actually a good place to learn because the waves are not huge. Club Med takes up most of the beachfront, which means the beach road stays quiet. All the action is on the second road, 100 metres back. Plenty of restaurants, small hotels, beer bars, and a proper night market hidden in the middle. The south end of Kata is now the busiest part, with terraces over the sand and places like The Boathouse and Beyond Resort Kata right there. The north end near the river is much more peaceful if you want a quiet stretch of sand. Kata Noi is just 500 metres south, separated by a small headland. Even softer sand, only three hotels, and the long legendary After Beach Bar on the cliff above. I worked at Club Med Kata in 1990. Back
